A hungry little adventure

Click or tap a spot in the maze. Your character follows the corridors and stops there. Tap another spot to change direction. Keyboard arrows also work.

25 points per muffin. Stars turn the bad guys into cookies: eat them for 200, 400, 800, then 1,600 points.

Start with 4 lives. Clear a level without losing a life to earn one extra, up to 6. Twenty levels, then endless play.
